HAIP needs to read your call log to add guest calls to their lead page.
If Android says this setting is restricted: open App info for HAIP Calls, tap the ⋮ menu, choose "Allow restricted settings", then try again.
If your phone records calls, pick the folder where it saves them. HAIP reads only that folder.

Usually: Samsung "Recordings/Call", Xiaomi "MIUI/sound_recorder/call_rec", OnePlus, Oppo or Realme "Recordings" or "Music/Recordings/Call Recordings". The Google Phone app cannot record calls; use Samsung Phone or a recording dialer.
Set battery use for HAIP Calls to "Unrestricted" so calls keep syncing in the background.
Turn off Wi-Fi calling in your phone settings: on many phones it stops calls being recorded.
